points: Why is 'squared' called squared and 'cubed' called cubed?
Where do powers and roots go in the order of operations?

panels.title: Islamic foundation
panels.text: Muhammad ibn Musa al-Khwarizmi (محمد بن موسى الخوارزمي), working in Baghdad in the 9th century, wrote a book on Hindu-Arabic numerals that spread place value and zero to the world. Our powers of ten and standard form rest on that place value system.
